title: PIPPEN: Player Impact from Pooled Priors and Estimated Noise
description:
Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus computed from public play-by-play for NBA 2016-17 through 2024-25, validated at a Spearman correlation of 0.914 against an independently constructed stint dataset. Shipped alongside it are the measured split-half reliability of fifteen box-score metrics across twenty-five seasons, and the possession coefficient measured per season rather than assumed at the conventional 0.44.

The project set out to fuse public metrics by weighting each by its reliability, and the measurements ruled that out: across this metric set reliability correlates -0.564 with correlation against RAPM. The fused rating does not predict next-season team net rating better than RAPM alone and is not statistically distinguishable from it, a negative result published rather than omitted.
